subject: IF directive
notes: SR6 (cite.py --check 7.3.16.3 OK): 'Text-1 and text-2 may be any kind of source lines, including compiler directives. Text-1 and text-2 may consist of multiple lines.' Render treats every non-directive line as text (block/omitted) and every directive line in a branch through the same switch with ParentActive frames. Probes: p08 nested >>IF/>>ELSE/>>END-IF and a >>DEFINE inside text-1 (N-TT, Z5 correct); p20 non-COBOL garbage, a missing-copybook COPY and >>SOURCE FORMAT FREE in the omitted text-1, and >>TURN + a multi-line DISPLAY in text-2 -> compiles, prints OK1 OK2. The pb1006 golden derives its expected output from §7.2.1 Step 1 and §7.3.16.4 GR2/GR3 with a directive in the false path. || REFUTED: CONFORMS with test-ref EMPTY. The implementation conforms, but pb1006_source_format_in_false_path does not pin SR6: it pins §7.2.1 Step 1 (SOURCE FORMAT processed in the false path) and §7.3.16.4 GR2/GR3, and every text-1/text-2 in it is a single line, so the 'Text-1 and text-2 may consist of multiple lines' half is never exercised. A golden with multi-line texts carrying nested directives (IF, EVALUATE, DEFINE) in both branches would close the row. — Behaviour conforms and survived attack. Probe t2 put a nested >>EVALUATE, a nested IF/ELSE/END-IF and a >>DEFINE in an omitted multi-line text-1, and a nested EVALUATE with WHEN OTHER, >>PAGE, >>DEFINE, a nested IF and a two-line DISPLAY in an included text-2. The output was exactly G1 G2: the omitted DEFINE took no effect and the included one did. The false path also tolerated an unterminated literal, an invalid column-7 indicator, a continued literal and an incomplete COPY REPLACING (u1-u4). The refutation is the test-ref only. The cited golden is spec-derived, but for a different rule and branch set, and it leaves SR6's multiple-lines half unpinned, so it cannot close this row. || editions (adjudicator): 2002, 2014, 2023 (the §7.3 compiler-directive facility, incl. conditional compilation, is absent from COBOL-85; the pinned compiler gates >>IF at --std 85 with COBOL0900, probe p01)
